meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

howto.what: Claude会告诉用户运行`bash nanoclaw.sh`完成NanoClaw设置。脚本处理依赖、容器镜像、OneCLI vault、Anthropic凭据、服务、首个agent及可选渠道;出错时借助Claude恢复。
howto.when: 当用户提到“setup”“install”“configure nanoclaw”等关键词,或提出首次设置请求时触发。

say.note: Claude 会引导你运行设置脚本。
Claude 会让你执行设置脚本。
Claude 将指导你的首次配置。

howto.what_en: Claude tells the user to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`; that script sets up dependencies, container image, OneCLI vault, Anthropic credential, service, first agent, and optional channels; on errors, it offers Claude-assisted recovery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or asks for first-time setup.

say_en.note: Claude will guide you to run the setup script.
